title: Custom GPTs are retiring: what changes

captions.linkedin:
OpenAI has officially announced the retirement of Custom GPTs, scheduled for December 11, 2026, and their transition toward Plugins.

This does not mean GPT models or AI agents are disappearing. It is a change in how customized assistants are structured within ChatGPT. What was organized through GPT Instructions and Knowledge is moving toward a more modular system built around skills, reference files and connected applications. Existing Custom Actions may require additional configuration or new integrations, including MCP where appropriate.

The interesting part is the clearer separation between instructions, knowledge and tools. These components become more reusable and independently manageable.

From an AI engineering perspective: are we entering a phase where context architecture matters just as much as the underlying model?

My own content system already works this way.

OpenAI FAQ: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001519-custom-gpt-retirement-and-migration-faq
